thread:
noah: Heads-up  during the keystore rotation this morning we started seeing increased mTLS rejects in two regions. Proxy 502s and keystore logs show early RBAC denies. Anyone watching?

tara: saw the alert. Which clusters affected?

noah: apac-prod and eu-stable. Example logs from keystore: 
```
2026-07-08T01:22:13Z keystore-0 INFO rbac: principal=svc-gateway.apac check=decrypt result=DENY reason=missing-subject
```

vijay: Missing-subject usually means the RoleBinding rendered without the service account subject. Did the rotation script regenerate bindings?

noah: we ran rotation job v2 which also reconciles rolebindings. It looks like a rendering edge-case dropped subjects for clusters where namespace mapping was empty. Pipeline job: https://ci.internal/pipelines/keystore-rotation/421

kevin: Two issues to fix immediately: (A) restore correct RoleBindings in affected clusters; (B) improve telemetry so early-deny emits an audit stub to the logshipper (so KMS audit isn't the only source).

ops-oncall: I can patch APAC now. Before changing, collect artifacts: kube-audit events for the RoleBinding apply, encoded rendered manifest, keystore logs, and proxy envoy logs (grab peer_cert_sha256 and SNI).

noah: helper commands: 
```
kubectl --context=apac-prod -n infra get rolebinding keystore-svc -o yaml > /tmp/keystore-apac-binding.yaml
kubectl -n services logs proxy-12 --since=30m | grep peer_cert_sha256 | head -n 5
kubectl --context=apac-prod get events --field-selector reason=RoleBindingUpdated -o wide
```

ops-oncall: patch applied to apac-prod and keystore restarted. Rolling eu-stable next.

~4m later~

ops-oncall: After fixes, handshake reject rate in APAC dropped from 2.9% -> 0.15%. EU finish patch now.

vijay: Postmortem actions: 1) fix renderer to always emit namespace-qualified subjects; 2) add a CI preflight "canary-decrypt" that runs in-cluster as the target SA after apply; 3) add an `early_deny_audit` stub emitted to logshipper when keystore returns DENY without calling KMS (fields: principal, reason, sni, peer_cert_sha256, trace_id); 4) add metric keystore_rbac_early_deny_total{region} and alert if rate > 0.5% for 3m.

tara: also ensure kube-audit retains RoleBinding change events for 90 days and that audit-bot links those event IDs to incident tickets. audit-bot: please create an incident and attach current artifacts.

audit-bot: Incident INC-2026-300 created: "Keystore RBAC rendering bug caused multi-region mTLS rejects". Attached artifacts: keystore logs, rendered-manifest snapshots, kube-audit event IDs. PD notified.

kevin: small follow-up: add an invariant check in the rotation job that fails if rendered binding subjects do not include expected SAs. Prevents silent drift.

noah: will open PRs for renderer fix, canary job, and keystore audit stub. Assigning: noah->renderer PR, vijay->canary + runbook, kevin->metric + alerts, tara->audit retention confirmation.

ops-oncall: recommend rollout pattern change: apply to single canary cluster, run canary-decrypt, then roll to remaining clusters. Avoid global swap.

noah: thanks all. We'll run a brief blameless postmortem and close tasks in the incident board.
